column1: # Measured wall-clock seconds per Maestro flow, per platform. Read by runMaestroFlows.sh to balance the CI shards
# (longest-processing-time-first bin packing), and held current by packages/tools/repoGuards/__tests__/maestroShardPartition.test.ts.
# Columns (tab separated): platform, flow, seconds, samples.
#   seconds = MEDIAN over samples of the flow's span in the CI log, from its `##[group]maestro flow <name>` line to the
#             next `##[endgroup]` (reset, driver start and flow, as the runner prints them). A flow that printed
#             `FLOW FAILED` and any span under 15 s (a flow that died at launch) is not a sample.
#   samples = how many passing spans the median is over. 0 means NO passing measurement exists, and the row holds the
#             platform median (the `*` row) instead. Replace it when a green run times the flow.
#   flow `*` = the weight a flow with NO row at all is scheduled with (the platform median of the measured flows).
# Sources: workflow `CI - PR (sandbox)` on chore/code-quality-enforcement-phase-1-2, runs 39153198436 39165813897
# A stale row costs shard BALANCE, never correctness: every flow still runs on exactly one shard.
